interpretation_of_gross_tote_weight.implication_for_FC_K2: Allocated Kerry Oil Gross Mass (4,953 kg) = oil + leftover residue, NOT (oil + tote tares + deck items). Skill spec FC-K2 calls for transport-EF basis = BOL gross including tote tares; current basis EXCLUDES tote tares. Likely under-counts transport process load by ~240 kg (4 × 60 kg tote tare). Without BOL, cannot confirm Charm/Kerry's intended convention.
